MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Deck Plus screws match my recent interest in #10 outdoor deck screws, with a slightly shorter length that could suit related work.",
    "Recommending wood screws reflects my repeated interest in fastening supplies across several recent purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Epoxies, construction adhesive and repair tapes serve different purposes from the nails and screws I have been choosing; I have no specific repair need for them now.",
    "The lag bolts are much thicker than my recent screws, so being intended for wood does not make them interchangeable.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase does not imply a need for industrial degreaser or twelve wastebaskets, and nothing suggests I need caulk storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat general construction and repair supplies as equally relevant to my more specific fastener shopping.",
    "One vacuum-maintenance purchase seems to have been stretched into a broader interest in cleaning and waste supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Dimensions and intended use matter: screw diameter, length and outdoor suitability make the deck screws a closer match than large lag bolts.",
    "My repeated nail and screw purchases give clearer evidence of current needs than isolated purchases of unrelated supplies.",
    "Pack size needs a plausible purpose; six adhesive cartridges or twelve wastebaskets would require a need my history does not establish."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in fastening supplies but expanded it too broadly into unrelated repair and maintenance needs."
}
